decisions.reason: The flagship citrus crate is built on sunk tooling, costs little to keep, and serves a growing reusable agricultural packaging niche, so the option stays open even though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds some doubt.

Foldable large containers are core to returnable packaging demand from automotive and pooling customers, and keeping the line costs little, so abandoning it is not justified despite the missing website evidence.

The stackable crate line uses established tooling and is cheap to maintain, but its low visibility and lack of recent evidence make it the most likely candidate for pruning, without yet clearly justifying a drop.
The spill-retention pallet serves a regulated industrial niche with steady but uncertain demand, and its low holding cost favours keeping the option rather than writing it off.
